name: Anti-Aging Cleanser with Peptides
descriptor: A fresh start. A softer feel.
description: A peptide-enriched facial cleanser with glycerin and panthenol. Cleanses away daily buildup while helping skin feel comfortable.
directions: Massage a small amount onto damp skin, then rinse thoroughly. Use morning and evening.

name: Hydrating Tonic
descriptor: A little hydration. Before everything else.
description: An aloe-based tonic with glycerin and sodium PCA. A light hydration step after cleansing, before your chosen serum.
directions: Sweep over the face and neck with a cotton pad after cleansing. Use morning and evening.

name: Exfoliating Pads
description: Pre-moistened pads with mandelic, lactic and salicylic acids. A focused exfoliating step for uneven texture and congested-looking skin.
directions: After cleansing, gently sweep one pad over the entire face or targeted areas of the face and body, then follow with moisturizer. Recommended for nighttime use. Avoid the eye area. Sunburn Alert: This product contains an alpha hydroxy acid (AHA) that may increase your skin’s sensitivity to the sun and particularly the possibility of sunburn. Use a sunscreen, wear protective clothing, and limit sun exposure while using this product and for a week afterwards.
inci: Water (Aqua), Butylene Glycol, Lactic Acid, Mandelic Acid, Glycerin, Polysorbate 20, Phenoxyethanol, Sodium Hydroxide, Salicylic Acid, Ethylhexylglycerin, Disodium EDTA, Hamamelis Virginiana (Witch Hazel) Water, Propanediol, Chamomilla Recutita (Matricaria) Flower Extract, Glycyrrhiza Glabra (Licorice) Root Extract, Camellia Sinensis Leaf Extract, Sodium Carbonate, Sodium Chloride, Salix Alba (Willow) Bark Extract, Arctostaphylos Uva-Ursi Leaf Extract, Benzoic Acid, Linalool, Linalyl Acetate, Citrus Aurantium Bergamia Peel Oil, Limonene, Lavandula Oil Extract

name: Hydra C + Ferulic Serum
description: A vitamin C and ferulic acid serum with sodium hyaluronate. Designed to bring antioxidant care and hydration to a routine for dull or uneven-looking skin.
ingredients: Vitamin C, ferulic acid and sodium hyaluronate
directions: After cleansing and toning, apply a small amount to entire face and neck. Once absorbed, follow with moisturizer and/or sun protection products (SPF). May be used twice daily.
inci: Propylene Glycol, Ascorbic Acid, Butylene Glycol, Ethoxydiglycol, Hydroxypropyl Cellulose, Ferulic Acid, Sodium Hyaluronate, Allyl Methacrylates Crosspolymer, Fragrance

name: Retinol Rx
descriptor: An evening ritual. A renewed look.
description: An encapsulated retinol serum with niacinamide and squalane. An evening treatment for the appearance of fine lines and uneven texture.
directions: Apply 3-4 times per week and gradually increase to daily use. Use sparingly around the eye area. Recommended for PM use only. Wear sunscreen of SPF 30 or higher. Do not use if pregnant or breastfeeding.

name: Firming Peptide Eye Gel
description: A cooling peptide eye gel with aloe and cucumber water. A light, targeted step for smoother-looking skin around the eyes.
directions: Gently apply around the eye area after cleansing, avoiding direct contact with eyes. May be used twice daily.
